title: Get union of items when using multiple disjunctiveFacetsRefinements
body:
<!--
  Thanks for participating in this project! We will try to answer as soon as possible 🙏
-->

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe 🙏**
Okay... so my case scenario is that I want to get all items (posts) which are either in a particular category or in a particular tag... I thought disjunctive facets would sort the issue for me... but they don't. Only posts that have one of the specified category *AND* one of the specified tags are returned.


**Describe the solution you'd like 🤔**
To solve this, would like union not intersection of all disjunctive facet refinements... i.e. All items that have any of the specified tags `UNION` all of the items that have any of the specified categories.

**Describe alternatives you've considered ✨**
Well, I have tried disjunctive facets 🙃

**Additional context**
Trying to replace WooCommerce' related product algorithm with Algolia instant search using current product's categories/tags.
